question: You are implementing SAP S/4HANA Cloud, public edition for your customer. How are your customer systems activated? A. Via the SAP Contact Center B. Via the Central Business Configuration System C. Via the SAP Cloud ALM D. Via the SAP Business Technology Platform
discussion: B. Via the Central Business Configuration System Why? When implementing SAP S/4HANA Cloud, public edition, the Central Business Configuration (CBC) System is the tool used to manage and activate the customer's systems. CBC allows you to configure, implement, and manage SAP cloud solutions, including SAP S/4HANA Cloud. It helps guide the setup of the solution and handles activities like scope selection, system activation, and configuration management. The other options, while useful in the broader SAP ecosystem, are not specifically responsible for activating systems during the SAP S/4HANA Cloud implementation process: SAP Contact Center is a communication tool. SAP Cloud ALM is used for application lifecycle management. SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is a platform for developing and integrating applications but not for system activation in the context of S/4HANA Cloud implementations. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: Which of the following tools facilitate secure communication between SAP cloud solutions and protected on-premise networks that CANNOT be accessed directly from the Internet? A. Identity Authentication service B. SAP Business Technology Platform C. SAP Connectivity service D. Cloud Integration Automation service
discussion: C. SAP Connectivity service Why? The SAP Connectivity service facilitates secure communication between SAP cloud solutions and protected on-premise networks that cannot be accessed directly from the internet. It provides secure tunneling, ensuring that cloud applications can communicate with on-premise systems while maintaining security and privacy. The other options serve different purposes: Identity Authentication service manages user authentication and identity management. SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) provides a platform for developing and managing applications. Cloud Integration Automation service helps automate integration processes but does not specifically manage secure connectivity between cloud and on-premise environments. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: Which of the following is the customer's responsibility in both on-premise and private cloud scenarios? A. Database B. Servers C. Middleware D. Operating system
discussion: C. Middleware Why? In both on-premise and private cloud scenarios, middleware is typically the customer’s responsibility. Middleware refers to the software that connects applications and ensures proper communication between different systems, whether on-premise or in the cloud. In on-premise scenarios, customers are responsible for managing their entire IT infrastructure, including databases, servers, operating systems, and middleware. In private cloud scenarios, while the cloud provider might manage aspects such as servers, operating systems, and databases, the customer remains responsible for handling middleware configurations and ensuring that their systems are properly integrated. Database, Servers, and Operating System responsibilities are typically managed by the cloud provider in a private cloud environment. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: When doing a new implementation on premise or private cloud. which system is recommended to demonstrate standard functionality in the Explore phase? A. Starter B. Sandbox C. Trial D. Development
discussion: B. Sandbox Why? The Explore phase is a key stage in the SAP Activate methodology used for SAP S/4HANA implementations. It focuses on understanding the business requirements, validating standard SAP processes, and designing the solution. In both on-premise and private cloud new implementations, the Sandbox system is recommended during the Explore phase to demonstrate standard functionality. The Sandbox environment allows for safe experimentation, testing, and demonstration of standard SAP S/4HANA functionalities without impacting the actual development or production systems. It is an ideal environment to show end-users and stakeholders how the system works in practice. Starter system is typically used in cloud public editions (not on-premise or private cloud). Trial systems are usually used for initial evaluations but not in formal project phases. Development systems are for customizing and developing solutions after the Explore phase. The Sandbox environment provides flexibility for testing and exploring system capabilities. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
